# Equifax Partners with Kikoff to Support Financial Opportunities For Thin-File and Credit Invisible Consumers


August 31, 2026


#### Highlights:


-


Equifax has partnered with AI-driven credit building platform Kikoff to help the 76 million thin-file or "credit-invisible" U.S. consumers create fuller financial pictures.


-


The integration of alternative data not included in traditional credit reports – such as rental, utilities, and telecommunications payment histories – can help transform everyday financial behaviors into verifiable, scoreable credit assets.


An estimated 76 million U.S. adults have no credit file or have a[thin credit file, meaning they have a limited credit history of four accounts or fewer in their traditional credit file](https://www.equifax.com/newsroom/all-news/-/story/alternative-data-your-frequently-asked-questions-answered/) . While many of these consumers may lack traditional credit tradelines, they may have regularly met other debt obligations that can help to create a fuller financial picture.


Alternative data is Fair Credit Reporting Act-compliant information not typically included in a traditional credit report such as rental, utilities, and telecommunications payment histories. While traditional credit reports remain a strong indicator of credit history and past financial reliability, alternative data can responsibly expand access to credit and support a more inclusive economy. The integration of alternative data can help transform everyday financial behaviors into verifiable, scoreable credit assets.


By partnering with companies like Kikoff, an AI-powered personal finance platform and formal data furnisher with over 1 million users, Equifax is leveraging its alternative data assets along with the power of[The Equifax Cloud™](https://www.equifax.com/about-equifax/equifax-cloud/) and patented[EFX.AI](http://efx.ai/) capabilities to help make mainstream financial services opportunities more accessible to more consumers.


One example of that is through the integration of[Optimal Path™ into Kikoff’s platform. Optimal Path is](https://www.equifax.com/business/product/optimal-path) a free interactive score planner from Equifax that analyzes a consumer's credit profile and delivers personalized, actionable plans for achieving specific credit score goals, helping them make smarter financial decisions no matter where they are in their financial journey.


#### Turning Everyday Payments into Verified Credit Assets


Another way to build a positive credit profile is to establish a first tradeline. Through direct integration with the Equifax reporting infrastructure,[Kikoff](https://kikoff.com/) provides members with clear entry points into the credit mainstream:


-


**Dedicated Credit Account Tradelines:** For individuals starting with no credit history, Kikoff establishes a retail tradeline that reports monthly balance and payment data of Kikoff plan payments directly to Equifax, establishing consistent, positive records with low credit utilization.


-


**Retroactive Rent Reporting:** Rent can be a consumer’s largest monthly expense, but may not always be reported. Renters can ask their landlords to report their rental payment history to Equifax or self-enroll in a rent reporting service to ensure their payments are being documented on their credit file. Kikoff’s rent reporting integration allows users to backfill up to 24 months of submitted on-time rental payments into their Equifax report in a single action, designed for responsible renters looking to build a scoreable credit record.


#### Focus on Data Accuracy


As consumers actively build their profiles with these new tradelines and alternative data sources, ensuring the integrity of that information is essential. Equifax is always working to make its credit reports as accurate and reliable as possible, with 99.83% U.S. consumer report accuracy in July 2026.


U.S. consumers can receive their free Equifax credit report on the[myEquifax website](https://www.equifax.com/personal/credit-report-services/free-credit-reports/) or through the[myEquifax app](https://www.equifax.com/personal/education/personal-finance/articles/-/learn/myequifax-app/) . Additionally, all Kikoff users receive free access to their Equifax credit report in Kikoff’s platform, so they can maintain visibility into their finances.


#### Driving Impact and Financial Opportunity at Scale


Fintech innovation and scalable reporting infrastructure are transforming how consumers build credit. The Equifax partnership with Kikoff offers real-time proof that alternative data like rental payment history reporting can help open up more credit opportunities for more consumers. Learn how Equifax enables fintechs and other businesses to[extend more credit to more consumers with confidence using alternative data](https://www.equifax.com/business/use-alternative-data-to-evaluate-credit-risk/) .
